readout_other: reversal behaviour (proportion reversing); GCaMP5.0 calcium imaging of ALM and PLM neurons
direction_notes: Ultrasound evoked reversal behaviour in 85% of wild-type worms, reduced in mec-4 (30%) and mec-6 (10%) mutants; ALM and PLM neurons showed increased GCaMP5.0 fluorescence.
safety_notes: Cavitation was checked by LDV frequency scan (no harmonics or wideband noise); temperature rise described as small but not quantified.

exposures.label: 27.4 MHz SAW device, single 6.4 ms pulse, C. elegans on agar

target.label: ALM and PLM neurons expressing MEC-4 and MEC-6 ion channels

device.model: interdigital transducer (IDT) surface acoustic wave device on 128 deg YX-LiNbO3 substrate

timing.protocol_description: Worms moved freely on the agar surface for 5 min and were then stimulated with a single-pulse ultrasound (input electronic power: 5 W, pulse duration: 6.4 ms). Twenty worms per group.

source_quotes.n_subjects: Twenty C. elegans were used in each group, and the proportion of C. elegans that exhibits reversal behavior under ultrasound stimulation was analyzed based on the video.
source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: The resonant frequency of the IDTs was 27.4 MHz, measured by a network analyzer (ZVA40, Rohde and Schwarz, Muenchen, Germany)
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.sonication_duration_: then was stimulated with a single-pulse ultrasound (input electronic power: 5 W, pulse duration: 6.4 ms)
source_quotes.exposures[0].device.manufacturer: The IDTs were fabricated by a standard microelectromechanical technology
source_quotes.exposures[0].device.model: The IDTs were fabricated by a standard microelectromechanical technology
source_quotes.exposures[0].free_field.pressure_kpa: In the experiment, when the input electronic power was 5 W, the maximum vibration amplitude of agar plate was 11 nm and the corresponding acoustic pressure calculated by (1) was approximately 3 MPa.

flags.reason: Only group sizes given: 20 per behavioural group (6 genotypes), ALM n=9, PLM n=8; no total. The 20 appears in the figure legend as spaced digits.
Approximately 3 MPa calculated from LDV vibration amplitude on the agar surface at 5 W input; the paper does not label the domain.
Single 6.4 ms pulse treated as one continuous burst; 6.4 ms is stated as 'pulse duration'.
IDT fabricated by MEMS technology; builder not named, so recorded as custom_built.
